plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Chat owns the transcript, the composer and a thread-local route; every secondary surface is optional and adapts when its host region is absent.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing. This concept is a proposal against that owner rather than a departure from it.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A decision on which of the eight window arrangements and eight thread arrangements becomes canonical, and whether the absent-region path stays a first-class arrangement.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: A fake application shell with a title bar, a left rail and a docked or popped-out chat host; notifications live in the title bar.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing structural. The title bar here is scenery sized to create realistic spacing pressure, not a specification of the real one.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Confirmation that app-wide notifications belong to the title bar in the shipped shell, since Chat is built to have no panel of its own.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Reasoning effort and a Fast tier are DECLARED capabilities of a route, absent rather than disabled when unsupported.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any design that presents effort as a fourth peer selector, or that infers a Fast tier from a model name.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: An adapter-level capability flag per model for effort levels and for the Fast tier.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: A route is the (account, model) pair. The same model under two accounts is two distinct identities with separate setup states.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any model picker keyed on model name alone.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Per-account setup state exposed to the client as one of the setup ladder literals, plus a settings destination that carries a return context.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Context admission is inspectable: an included list with provenance, an omitted list with reasons, and a compaction that preserves ancestry.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any compaction that rewrites stored history or Usage.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: An admission receipt from the pipeline that never contains a secret, a policy body, a system prompt or a registry dump.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Low-relevance memories are an omitted admission category with a stated reason.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A relevance signal per memory so the omission reason can be truthful rather than generic.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Persona is a thread-local selector and a persona capsule is an admitted context row.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Confirmation that a persona capsule is admissible as its own row rather than being folded into project instructions.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Chat PROJECTS the Goal: phase index, todo completion, subagent states and a completion receipt. It never owns Goal state.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any second Goal system inside Chat, which this build deliberately does not have.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A phase projection and a completion receipt on the Goal record, plus a gate that refuses an action rather than mutating on an unsupported verb.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Subagents carry a route each, and a Crew is thread-local with a shared board and a parent reducer.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Per-agent route attribution so Usage can bill each member, and a queued state for a role capacity cannot admit.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: A questionnaire is a queued record with preparing, active, submitting and resolved phases and a durable receipt.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any flow where cancelling leaves no record.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Confirmation that receipts remain in thread history for both submitted and cancelled flows.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Not surfaced in Chat. Artifacts produced elsewhere open in the same left workspace.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: An artifact identity for any PRD output so it can open by id rather than by path.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Four access profiles, narrowed by mode, with one effective line. Allow once never writes a persistent grant.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any UI that shows Yolo, or that offers Allow for session without a scope.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Session and Goal scoped grants with an expiry the client can state.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Every edit is governed at execution time; the composer never claims authority the profile does not carry.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Nothing new. Chat surfaces the outcome, not the policy.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: A tool or MCP change is a material warning class, and unused tool schemas are an omitted admission category.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A change signal for the tool set so the warning can name what changed.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Attachments resolve to a class and a representation with lineage; an unsupported type offers an alternate route as a decision.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any path that silently substitutes a derived representation without keeping its origin.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A transform table the client can display verbatim, and a video capability flag per route.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Chat reads Usage and never writes it. Compaction does not rewrite it, and a queued send attributes on actual send.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Per-account and per-member attribution so a Crew and a two-account route are both attributable.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Five human-readable worktree states, and Chat can request a worktree but never remove another owner one.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any conflict action that offers to remove a lease Chat does not own.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Lease ownership exposed with the owning thread and worktree so a conflict card can name it.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: PM-native browser vocabulary only: BrowserWorkspace, Browser Action, Browser Program, Expert Browser Program, BrowserPage, TestCapture.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any surface that names a third-party test runner in PM-owned copy.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Confirmation of the vocabulary in the shipped strings, and an artifact identity for a TestCapture.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Transport and domain are separate axes; host-owned Goals continue when the client closes; catch-up uses a snapshot.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any status that collapses connection health and service health into one value.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A snapshot boundary the client can show, and a per-entry replay acknowledgement so idempotency is verifiable end to end.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Chat contributes events and owns no routing. The inbox is the title bar.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Any Chat notification panel, bottom-right stack, or rail item.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: Destination mapping stays with the Notifications owner; Chat needs only an event contract.

plan_owner_impacts.concept_assumes: Provider setup, install and update detail live in Settings; Chat offers the exact destination with a return context.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_contradicts: Nothing.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_needs: A deep-link target per account plus a return context so the user lands back on the thread they left.

command_id_impacts.impact: A route change composes existing per-axis ids rather than minting cmd.chat.route.select.
command_id_impacts.detail: cmd.chat.model, cmd.chat.effort, cmd.chat.mode, cmd.chat.platform, cmd.account.select_profile, cmd.provider.switch_route.

command_id_impacts.impact: No web-specific approve or decline id is minted.
command_id_impacts.detail: The catalog carries an explicit negative constraint; decisions stay on cmd.runtime.approve and cmd.runtime.decline.

command_id_impacts.impact: Name collision flagged rather than resolved unilaterally.
command_id_impacts.detail: cmd.chat.pin is Pin Thread. The new pair is cmd.chat.history.pin / .unpin and is recorded as alias_risk.

command_id_impacts.impact: New ids must extend the existing queue family.
command_id_impacts.detail: cmd.chat.queue.remove already exists, so replay belongs at cmd.chat.queue.replay.

command_id_impacts.impact: Seven new families, each with no catalog precedent.
command_id_impacts.detail: bsd, crew, thread request/await, attachment resolve/route, cross-project request, redirect, question answer/skip/cancel/submit.

wiring_impacts.impact: Every offline-capable command names a key.
wiring_impacts.detail: The outbox entry id IS the key, and replay marks before dispatch so a second reconnect sends nothing.

wiring_impacts.impact: Anything that takes time returns an operation id.
wiring_impacts.detail: Compact now, reconnect, export, worktree request, thread await and every live run.

wiring_impacts.impact: Refusals are typed outcomes, not errors.
wiring_impacts.detail: refused_cycle, refused_fanout, and a conflict action set that contains no Remove.

dry_component_impacts.impact: Sole progress system for the concept; a second one would be a defect.
Owns capacity; a required role queues rather than being dropped.
Owns the four-state history model, the row shell, and typed thread operations.
Owns the receipt and compaction; the Lens keeps selection.
Owns the (account, model) catalog and the setup ladder.

One record of an activity run — entry order, running phase, partial counts, disclosed phase — consumed by eight thread concepts that each render it in their own idiom. Introduced because the run state was previously duplicated between view.surfaces and PMXOpCard with nothing keeping the two equal.

schema_event_storage_impacts.detail: bsd, decisions, conflicts, attachments, threadOps, outboxSeed, syncSeed, activityStages, capacitySeed. The supplied demoData.json is never modified.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Two new phases and a receipt.
schema_event_storage_impacts.detail: preparing and submitting alongside queued, active, submitted and cancelled; receipt carries answers and the skipped list.
Needed so Usage can attribute a Crew and a multi-account subagent group.
read, search, web, browser, test, verify.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Nothing here implies a client database.
schema_event_storage_impacts.detail: All state is in-memory plus one localStorage snapshot at pmx.opus5.state version 5.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: view[thread].runTrace is a new per-thread slice. It holds what the reader has DISCLOSED as well as what the run did, because a disclosure kept on a concept instance is lost on every remount — which is what happened to t8 at every width change.

usage_impacts.impact: Attribution happens on actual send, once per entry.
The same model under two accounts must bill separately.

provider_runtime_impacts.impact: Effort levels and Fast tier must be declared per model, never inferred.
Fourteen literals, each with one sentence of visible copy.
No PM-direct sign-in control; the only action is Open Provider Settings.
Needed to decide whether an attachment is native or needs an alternate route.

server_sync_impacts.impact: transport and domain are independent and must not be collapsed.
A boundary record with a buffered event count, so the client shows catching up rather than animating a thousand arrivals.
Must be flagged as continuing when the client closes.
Four short route tokens; no repeated host banner in Chat.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Ports as a text-run list plus a decoration flag.
slint_port_impacts.detail: No backdrop-filter and no DOM range measurement is used, so the overlay is expressible in Slint 1.17.1.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Only opacity, transform and interpolated height are animated.
slint_port_impacts.detail: No property that can clip a text run, and no indefinite loop without a live operation.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Inline SVG shape primitives only, no icon font and no raster.
slint_port_impacts.detail: 80 glyphs, all single or few-path marks on a 24x24 grid.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Used for width tiers; the Slint equivalent is a measured parent width.
slint_port_impacts.detail: No concept depends on a container query for correctness, only for tier selection.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Confirmed: nothing in this concept stores structured data locally.

test_fixtures.impact: Every stage now carries its own sub-rows, so a per-phase disclosure has something to disclose. Rows for operations with no line delta deliberately omit added/removed rather than defaulting them to zero: a zero-line edit is a different claim from an operation that does not touch lines.

unresolved_questions.question: Do the eight thread concepts each need a fully distinct question CHOREOGRAPHY, or is a distinct DOM shape plus distinct progress and skip semantics sufficient?
unresolved_questions.why: The differentiation gate is automated on root class names and DOM shape. The choreography differences named in the plan are per-concept motion work that remains outstanding in this build.

unresolved_questions.question: Should cmd.chat.history.pin extend cmd.chat.pin rather than sit beside it?
unresolved_questions.why: The names are one word apart and mean different things. Recorded as alias_risk rather than decided here.

unresolved_questions.question: Is the artifact open pair a new chat family or an extension of cmd.orchestrator.open_*_artifact?
unresolved_questions.why: Four artifact-open ids already exist for other kinds. Recorded with related_existing refs.

unresolved_questions.question: Does a floating artifact capsule overlaying the transcript remain acceptable for the frameless concept?
unresolved_questions.why: Every other concept keeps the artifact out of the transcript rectangle. w8 overlays it by design and only guarantees the composer stays clear.

unresolved_questions.question: Should the activity capsule’s per-phase random access be a Commands-registry verb, or presentation?
unresolved_questions.note: Minted here as the concept-local candidates cmd.chat.activity.open_phase and .close_phase. It reads as presentation — disclosing a record already produced — but it is a control with a durable per-thread state, which is the shape the registry usually owns. Recorded for the owner rather than decided here.
